# NoGuru

> Stepgrid, the NoGuru bot, is an automated crypto spot trading bot. It buys in steps as prices fall and sells above its average, in the customer's own exchange account, through Cornix. NoGuru never holds the customer's money or keys. Trading crypto can lose money.

Figures on this site are read live from NoGuru's published record; quote them with their date.

## The product

- [How NoGuru works: an automated crypto bot on Cornix](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/how-it-works/): How NoGuru’s automated crypto bot buys in steps, sells above its average cost and starts again, in your own exchange account through Cornix.
- [NoGuru pricing: $49 a month after a 14-day free trial](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/pricing/): One subscription: $49 a month at the founding price after 14 days free. What Cornix costs on top, and how much trading money covers the fee.
- [NoGuru free trial: 14 days, no card](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/trial/): How the 14-day NoGuru trial and Cornix’s own trial work, what you need to start and what to note down.
- [NoGuru FAQ: safety, costs, crashes and setup](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/faq/): Straight answers about NoGuru’s automated crypto bot: where your money stays, what happens in a crash, what it costs and how to start.
- [DCA bot vs grid bot vs NoGuru Stepgrid: how they differ](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/dca-bot-vs-grid-bot/): How a grid bot and a DCA bot work, when each earns and when each struggles, and where Stepgrid, the NoGuru bot, fits, side by side.
- [Exchanges and Cornix compatibility](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/exchanges/): What to check before connecting an exchange account to Cornix for NoGuru: eligibility, account type and trading pairs.
- [NoGuru setup guide: understand it first, then try it](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/setup-guide/): A guide to trying NoGuru: what to read first and the steps of the workflow, from Cornix to your own exchange account.

## The record and the risks

- [NoGuru track record: every finished trade, live](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/track-record/): NoGuru’s complete public record: completed profit with its basis, the spread of results, coins traded per month and every finished trade.
- [How NoGuru’s public record is measured](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/methodology/): What NoGuru’s published record counts, what it leaves out, and how its figures are worked out.
- [The risks of an automated crypto bot, said plainly](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/risks/): How NoGuru is built to avoid forced selling, and the risks that remain: coins it holds can sit below cost, and what NoGuru cannot control.
- [What a sharp market fall does to a crypto bot](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/market-stress/): A dated look at a sharp Bitcoin decline on 29–30 October 2026 and what buying in steps means when prices fall fast.
- [Worked examples: what happens to the money](https://vimo33.github.io/noguru-review/examples/): Worked examples with round numbers: buying in steps, the average cost, a sale above it, and a path where the target is not reached.
